cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Could my bicycle come inside the cafe just this once?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Wonderful. I'll note rain as an accepted condition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow it's Jo on the counter. She'll put it back outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave Jo a note: 'Bicycle admitted in rain.' I'll show her that before I show her the bicycle.

mechanism: A treats a former counter pupil rain exception as good judgment to be recorded and carried over to the next staff member.
confusable: Not merely getting a one-off favor: A immediately turns the condition into a usable precedent for another day and decision-maker.
comparison: Cafe staff handover versus first administrative extension becoming tested practice.
seedUse: D176 bicycle/rain/cafe/Jo/note; S05 taught counter judgment and handover.
